description: ProxySQL 2.6/2.7 configuration rendered to /etc/proxysql.cnf (only read on a clean datadir or with --initial).

fields.description: Where proxysql.db lives. If that database already exists this file is ignored beyond this key.
fields.name: datadir
fields.title: Data directory

fields.description: Path of the ProxySQL error log.
fields.name: errorlog
fields.title: Error log

fields.description: user:password pairs for the admin interface (6032). Change it — the default admin:admin is only reachable from localhost.
fields.name: admin_credentials
fields.title: Admin credentials

fields.description: host:port list the admin interface listens on, semicolon-separated.
fields.name: admin_mysql_ifaces
fields.title: Admin interfaces

fields.description: Expose native Prometheus metrics through the REST API listener.
fields.name: restapi_enabled
fields.title: Metrics endpoint

fields.description: REST API and Prometheus listener port.
fields.name: restapi_port
fields.title: Metrics port

fields.description: host:port list the SQL proxy listens on; not changeable at runtime.
fields.name: interfaces
fields.title: Client interfaces

fields.description: Worker threads handling client traffic; not changeable at runtime. Size it to the CPU count.
fields.name: threads
fields.title: Worker threads

fields.description: Maximum client connections to the proxy (compiled default 10000, the shipped sample sets 2048).
fields.name: max_connections
fields.title: Max frontend connections

fields.description: Artificial delay before forwarding a query; a throttling knob, 0 in normal use.
fields.name: default_query_delay
fields.title: Default query delay

fields.description: Timeout for a query with no rule-level timeout.
fields.name: default_query_timeout
fields.title: Default query timeout

fields.description: Timeout of a single connection attempt to a backend.
fields.name: connect_timeout_server
fields.title: Backend connect timeout

fields.description: Event-loop poll timeout.
fields.name: poll_timeout
fields.title: Poll timeout

fields.description: Stack size of each worker thread; not changeable at runtime.
fields.name: stacksize
fields.title: Thread stack size

fields.description: Version string the proxy reports to clients; set it to the real backend version so drivers pick the right protocol.
fields.name: server_version
fields.title: Announced server version

fields.description: Schema used when a client connects without one.
fields.name: default_schema
fields.title: Default schema

fields.description: Character set assumed for clients that do not announce one.
fields.name: default_charset
fields.title: Default charset

fields.description: Client handshake collation; must match default_charset. The default matches Stroppy's utf8mb4 charset instead of the upstream utf8 collation.
fields.name: default_collation_connection
fields.title: Default collation

fields.description: Sort sessions by connection id to improve cache locality across threads.
fields.name: sessions_sort
fields.title: Sort sessions

fields.description: Collect per-command counters in stats_mysql_commands_counters.
fields.name: commands_stats
fields.title: Command statistics

fields.description: Account the monitor module uses for its health checks; needs USAGE and REPLICATION CLIENT.
fields.name: monitor_username
fields.title: Monitor user

fields.description: Password of that account; filled by the server.
fields.name: monitor_password
fields.title: Monitor password

fields.description: How long monitor check results are kept.
fields.name: monitor_history
fields.title: Monitor history

fields.description: How often the monitor opens a fresh connection to each backend.
fields.name: monitor_connect_interval
fields.title: Connect check interval

fields.description: How often the monitor pings each backend.
fields.name: monitor_ping_interval
fields.title: Ping interval

fields.description: How often read_only is polled — this is what moves a server between the writer and reader hostgroups.
fields.name: monitor_read_only_interval
fields.title: read_only check interval

fields.description: Timeout of one read_only check.
fields.name: monitor_read_only_timeout
fields.title: read_only check timeout

fields.description: How often idle pooled backend connections are pinged.
fields.name: ping_interval_server_msec
fields.title: Connection-pool ping interval

fields.description: Timeout of one such ping.
fields.name: ping_timeout_server
fields.title: Connection-pool ping timeout

fields.description: Frontend account clients authenticate with; must exist on the backends with the same password.
fields.name: username
fields.title: Application user

fields.description: Password of that account; filled by the server.
fields.name: password
fields.title: Application password

fields.description: Frontend connection limit for that user.
fields.name: user_max_connections
fields.title: Per-user max connections

fields.description: 1 pins a session to one hostgroup for the whole transaction — required for correctness with read/write split.
fields.name: transaction_persistent
fields.title: Transaction persistent

fields.description: Which hostgroup manager block is rendered: async/semisync replication (read_only based), group replication, Galera, or none (static hostgroups only).
fields.name: topology
fields.title: Backend topology

fields.description: Hostgroup id receiving writes.
fields.name: writer_hostgroup
fields.title: Writer hostgroup

fields.description: Hostgroup id receiving reads.
fields.name: reader_hostgroup
fields.title: Reader hostgroup

fields.description: Group Replication / Galera: members that could become primary.
fields.name: backup_writer_hostgroup
fields.title: Backup writer hostgroup

fields.description: Group Replication / Galera: members that left or fell too far behind.
fields.name: offline_hostgroup
fields.title: Offline hostgroup

fields.description: Which read_only flavor decides writer vs reader. Only these three are settable from the config file — the combined forms need the admin interface.
fields.name: check_type
fields.title: Replication check type

fields.description: Group Replication / Galera: how many members may sit in the writer hostgroup at once.
fields.name: max_writers
fields.title: Max writers

fields.description: 0 = writer stays out of the reader pool, 1 = writer also reads, 2 = only backup writers read.
fields.name: writer_is_also_reader
fields.title: Writer is also reader

fields.description: Group Replication / Galera: lag in transactions before a reader is shunned; 0 disables the check.
fields.name: max_transactions_behind
fields.title: Max transactions behind

fields.description: Render the two default rules: `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` to the writer, every other `SELECT` to the reader.
fields.name: read_write_split
fields.title: Read/write split

fields.description: The mysql_servers records; filled by the server from topology.
Backend host or IP.
fields.name: address
fields.title: Address

fields.description: Backend port.
fields.name: port
fields.title: Port

fields.description: Initial hostgroup id — writer_hostgroup for the primary, reader_hostgroup for replicas.
fields.name: hostgroup
fields.title: Hostgroup

fields.description: Use TLS for backend connections; required for fresh caching_sha2_password authentication.
fields.name: use_ssl
fields.title: Backend TLS

fields.description: Relative share of traffic inside its hostgroup.
fields.name: weight
fields.title: Weight

fields.description: Backend connection-pool limit for this server.
fields.name: max_connections
fields.title: Max connections

fields.name: mysql_servers
fields.title: Backends

fields.description: Raw `key = value` settings appended verbatim at the end of the file; keys must match ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_.]*$. Entry order is not preserved.
fields.name: custom
fields.title: Extra settings

computed.expr:
(("mysql_servers" in root) && size(root.mysql_servers) > 0) ? ("mysql_servers =
(
" + root.mysql_servers.map(s,
					"    { address="" + (("address" in s) ? string(s.address) : "") + "", port=" + (("port" in s) ? string(s.port) : "3306") +
					", hostgroup=" + (("hostgroup" in s) ? string(s.hostgroup) : "0") + ", weight=" + (("weight" in s) ? string(s.weight) : "1") +
					", max_connections=" + (("max_connections" in s) ? string(s.max_connections) : "1000") + ", use_ssl=" + (("use_ssl" in s) ? string(s.use_ssl) : "0") + " }").join(",
") + "
)
") : ""

fields.description: The backend list in libconfig record syntax.
fields.name: servers_block
fields.title: mysql_servers block

computed.expr:
"mysql_users =\n(\n    { username=\"" + string(root.username) + "\", password=\"" +
					(("password" in root) ? string(root.password) : "") +
					"\", default_hostgroup=" + string(root.writer_hostgroup) +
					", transaction_persistent=" + string(root.transaction_persistent) +
					", max_connections=" + string(root.user_max_connections) + ", active=1 }\n)\n"

fields.description: The single application account, routed to the writer hostgroup by default.
fields.name: users_block
fields.title: mysql_users block

computed.expr:
(root.read_write_split == "true") ? ("mysql_query_rules =
(
" +
					"    { rule_id=1, active=1, match_digest="^SELECT .* FOR UPDATE", destination_hostgroup=" + string(root.writer_hostgroup) + ", apply=1 },
" +
					"    { rule_id=2, active=1, match_digest="^SELECT", destination_hostgroup=" + string(root.reader_hostgroup) + ", apply=1 }
)
") : ""

fields.description: The read/write split rules; order matters — FOR UPDATE has to be matched first.
fields.name: query_rules_block
fields.title: mysql_query_rules block

computed.expr:
(root.topology == "replication") ? ("mysql_replication_hostgroups =\n(\n    { writer_hostgroup=" + string(root.writer_hostgroup) +
					", reader_hostgroup=" + string(root.reader_hostgroup) +
					", check_type=\"" + string(root.check_type) + "\" }\n)\n")
				: ((root.topology in ["group_replication", "galera"]) ? ("mysql_" + root.topology + "_hostgroups =\n(\n    { writer_hostgroup=" + string(root.writer_hostgroup) +
					", backup_writer_hostgroup=" + string(root.backup_writer_hostgroup) +
					", reader_hostgroup=" + string(root.reader_hostgroup) +
					", offline_hostgroup=" + string(root.offline_hostgroup) +
					", active=1, max_writers=" + string(root.max_writers) +
					", writer_is_also_reader=" + string(root.writer_is_also_reader) +
					", max_transactions_behind=" + string(root.max_transactions_behind) + " }\n)\n") : "")

fields.description: Replication, Group Replication or Galera hostgroup manager, selected by topology.
fields.name: hostgroups_block
fields.title: Hostgroup manager block

fields.description: The `custom` map joined into extra keys inside the mysql_variables block; values must already carry libconfig quoting.
fields.name: custom_rendered
fields.title: Rendered extra mysql_variables

rules.expr: !("writer_hostgroup" in root) || !("reader_hostgroup" in root) || int(root.writer_hostgroup) != int(root.reader_hostgroup)

!(root.topology in ["group_replication", "galera"]) || (root.backup_writer_hostgroup != root.writer_hostgroup && root.backup_writer_hostgroup != root.reader_hostgroup && root.backup_writer_hostgroup != root.offline_hostgroup && root.offline_hostgroup != root.writer_hostgroup && root.offline_hostgroup != root.reader_hostgroup && root.reader_hostgroup > 0)
rules.message: Group Replication and Galera need four distinct hostgroups, with a positive reader hostgroup

rules.expr: !("monitor_read_only_timeout" in root) || !("monitor_read_only_interval" in root) || int(root.monitor_read_only_timeout) < int(root.monitor_read_only_interval)
rules.message: monitor_read_only_timeout must be smaller than monitor_read_only_interval
